⚠️ **This type is _unstable_ and may change significantly in a way that the data won't be backwards compatible.**
Marks a chunk as resuming after a gap or recorder reset.

When true, the decoder state must be flushed before processing this chunk
and any accumulated resampler / overlap-add state discarded. Chunks
without this component are assumed continuous with the previous chunk on
the same timeline + [`components.AudioStreamId`](https://rerun.io/docs/reference/types/components/audio_stream_id?speculative-link).
